The Saturday Ride – Trek Fort Worth South

Fort Worth, TX · Southwest Fort Worth · Road

The Saturday Ride – Trek Fort Worth South is a road group ride in Fort Worth, TX. It rolls every Saturday at 8:00 am from Trek Bicycle Fort Worth South. About 28 miles, 15–17 mph average.

For visitors

Helmets required, lights recommended. Weather updates go on the shop's Facebook page; cancellations by Friday night.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 15–17 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It's a drop ride: if you can't hold the pace, you'll finish alone. Fine if you know your speed. Not a first ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the The Saturday Ride – Trek Fort Worth South group ride

An intermediate Saturday road ride from the Trek store on Granbury Road. About 28 miles at 15 to 17 mph. It is a drop ride, so be able to hold the pace. A route file is linked from the Eventbrite page.
